item.title: Show HN: CoachSheets–Zero-login worksheet delivery+AI session recaps for coaches
item.description:
I've spent the last ~40 days building CoachSheets, a worksheet platform for 1:1 coaches (life, business, fitness, etc). The core problem I kept hearing from coaches: clients ghost worksheets sent via email/PDF, and reviewing what came back eats a huge chunk of session-prep time.

What it does:

+ Sends worksheets to clients via a magic link — no app, no account, no login for the client + Generates an AI session recap from a completed worksheet in ~90 seconds instead of the 10-15 minutes it usually takes to read through manually + Can ingest a coach's existing PDF worksheets and digitize them automatically + 100+ built-in templates, 45+ interactive elements (sliders, canvases, card sorts, etc), drip programs for multi-session curricula

Free tier is 1 active client with full features, no credit card. Paid tiers start at $19/mo.

I also launched today on Product Hunt if you want to check it out there: [PH link]

Happy to answer questions about the build — it's a Laravel + Inertia.js + Vue stack, and I used Antigravity heavily throughout, which came with its own set of lessons about QA and consistency across pages.
